setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

starting_state: A new empty project, stopped, with Record off. The Pattern editor has not been opened and pattern 1 has no trigs.

steps.caption: In a new empty project with playback stopped and Record off, tap Pattern (5,8), then tap the fourth algorithm button (15,2) for Numeric. The Trig Algorithm screen marks Numeric as SELECTED. Numeric gives a sparse pattern, which makes shifts easy to see. The controls you will use on grid row 8 are Prime (16,8), Move left (10,8), Reset (11,8), Move right (12,8) and Cancel (14,8).
steps.title: Choose Numeric

steps.caption: Tap Prime (16,8). The Numeric pattern flashes on the grid and Paint Preview reads Preview PAINTING, Algorithm Numeric, Shift 0 and 8 trigs, on steps 5, 13, 21, 29 and so on. Nothing is painted yet.
steps.title: Prime the pattern

steps.caption: Tap Move right (12,8). Every flashing step moves one step to the right, from step 5 to step 6 and so on, and the Paint Preview screen reads Shift +1.
steps.title: Shift right

steps.caption: Tap Move left (10,8) twice. The first tap takes the flashing steps back to where Prime put them (Shift 0); the second moves them one step left of that, from step 5 to step 4 and so on. The screen reads Shift -1.
steps.title: Two taps left

steps.caption: Tap Reset (11,8). The shift returns to 0 in one tap and the flashing steps are back where Prime put them.
steps.title: Reset the shift

steps.caption: Tap Cancel (14,8). Paint Preview reads Preview OFF and Trigs NONE, and no flashing steps remain. Nothing was painted, so the pattern is unchanged. To keep a shifted rhythm instead, tap Prime again while the steps are flashing; the next two steps do that.
steps.title: Cancel the preview

steps.caption: Tap Prime (16,8) again. The same Numeric steps flash again at Shift 0. Prime always starts a new preview, so you can try a rhythm, cancel it and come back to it.
steps.title: Prime again

steps.caption: Tap Move right (12,8) so the preview reads Shift +1, then tap Prime (16,8) while the steps are flashing. Paint Preview now reads Preview OFF and the footer says Pattern painted. The steps stay lit on the pattern grid, one step to the right of where Prime first put them: the shifted rhythm is painted into the pattern.
steps.title: Press Prime again to paint the shifted rhythm

title: Move a rhythm before committing
